source.name: Footy Headlines: Adidas Neom SC 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released - No More Puma
source.note: Official 2026-27 kit launch report. The launch images show OXAGON as the front-of-shirt sponsor on both the home and the away shirt; the Saudi Pro League's official kit gallery shows the same OXAGON front on the home kit.

source.name: NEOM S.C. (club announcement): NEOM Sports Club and SHG forge strategic partnership to shape the future of sports and enterprise
source.note: Three-season partnership announced December 2025, covering 2026/27. The 2026-27 launch images and the league's official kit photo show only OXAGON on the shirt, so SHG's exact 2026/27 placement is to confirm.

summary: Adidas home kit (first Adidas season after Puma). OXAGON front-of-shirt. The club's December 2025 announcement also puts SHG on the front of the match jerseys for three seasons, but the 2026-27 launch images and the SPL's official kit photo show only OXAGON - SHG's 2026/27 placement is to confirm. No sleeve, back or shorts sponsor visible in the SPL's official kit photo; placements checked against it and the launch images.
